serving_findings.system_prompt_check: Rendered model inputs contained action, ambiguity and untrusted-data rules.

harness_limitations: Native tool schemas are narrowed for a pre-bound tab, not the whole brw catalog.
Model comparisons are model+quantization+prompt+adapter measurements; not architecture-only rankings.
Template-only reasoning-off was ineffective for 9B; explicit reasoning_effort:none fixed it.
Prose examples hurt MoE tool-call syntax; actual assistant tool-call history improved it.
Earlier exploratory drafts had a noncanonical keypress schema and omitted observed values; these were corrected before this recorded cohort.
